in_sanskrit.name: प्रेर्णा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who inspires, motivates, and encourages others. It is derived from the root word 'pre' which means 'to move' and 'rna' which means 'to call' or 'to encourage'. In Hindu mythology, Prerna is the name of a celestial nymph who is believed to inspire and encourage humans in their spiritual journey.

in_hindi.name: प्रेर्णा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who inspires and motivates. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prerana', which is a compound of 'pre' meaning 'to move' and 'rna' meaning 'to call' or 'to encourage'.

in_tamil.name: பிரென்னா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is in charge, the one who guides and leads, and the one who inspires and encourages. In Tamil, Prerna is written as 'பிரென்னா' and is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prerana'.

in_telugu.name: ప్రేర్ణా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who calls, the one who inspires, and the one who is desired. In Telugu, Prerna is written as 'ప్రేర్ణా' and is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prerana'.

in_marathi.name: Prerna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Inspiration, Direction, Aim, Desire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prerna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prerna is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'prarodh', meaning 'to inspire, to set in motion'. It signifies the feeling of inspiration or the sense of direction and aim, a deep-rooted desire to achieve something. In Hindu mythology, Prerna is believed to represent the inner voice that guides us towards our life's purpose.
